crossRefs.note: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck…
But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”
He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields, and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of…
Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of…
But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

translations.web: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.
translations.bsb: When you enter your neighbor’s grainfield, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you must not put a sickle to your neighbor’s grain.
translations.kjv: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour's standing corn.
translations.asv: When thou comest into thy neighbor's standing grain, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thy hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbor's standing grain.
